provenance.notes: Manually reconstructed from the inspected original flattened PDF figure. Ordinary labels are live typeable text; panels, graph geometry and arrows are native editable shapes or paths. Source layout and contents retained; font metrics, line widths and decorative effects approximated. Seven small original raster crops retain three robot-goal renderings and four decorative icons; all chart curves, axes, bars, panels, arrows and ordinary/formula labels are native. Tiny angle captions on photo backgrounds are overlaid with live native text. Mathematical text uses Unicode rather than live equation objects.
provenance.survey_crop_correction: Initial survey right488pt enlarged to535pt to include Update theta / Equation 5 feedback label.
provenance.visual_inspection: Original PDF figure inspected before source-layout reconstruction on 2026-10-09; independent application QA pending.
